sources.title: Kimi (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Kimi is an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot and series of large language models developed by Chinese company Moonshot AI. Its Kimi K3, released July 2026, is the largest open weights model at 2.8 trillion parameters. Moonshot releases the Kimi series of open weights large language models, available via web, API, and the Kimi Code command-line agent. These are capable of multimodal image ...
